newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Metalock invests S$14 mln in two firms.
newsitem.headline: Metalock invests S$14 mln in two firms.

text.p: Marine engineering firm Metalock (Singapore) Ltd said on Wednesday it would invest about Singapore $14.6 million in two companies, Aqua-Terra Supply Company Pte Ltd and Expressneed Pte Ltd.
The deal for Aqua-Terra, a stockist and distributor of oil field, marine and industry product supplies would give Metalock a 66.42 percent controlling stake, it said in a statement.
The deal for 3.45 million shares would cost S$14.6 million and was expected to have a positive effect on results said the statement.
Metalock said the investment would help it expand its oil and marine activities in the region.

In the second, related deal, Metalock said it would buy 700,000 shares for about S$650,000 in mechanical engineering firm Expressneed from Ng Kim Teck, who would use the proceeds of the sale to buy Aqua-Terra shares from Metalock.
The company said it was buying into Expressneed to allow Ng, a director of both Expressneed and Aqua-Terra, to devote more time to managing Aqua-Terra.
